scope: Pure combat model checks and static Unity adapter review; no visual/UI acceptance claim
runtime: Existing .NET 8 SDK; console harness links the actual RunModel.cs; no new tool installation
checks: new run has expected initial state
pause freezes movement and timer
resume advances simulation and input
diagonal movement has no speed advantage
player stays below reserved top HUD and sprite head extent
player stays above bottom HUD and sprite foot extent
EXP produces three distinct upgrade choices
invalid upgrade cannot resume run
selected upgrade applies once and resumes
duplicate selection is ignored
surplus EXP survives chained level-ups
character and permanent bonuses affect actual combat values
contact invulnerability prevents repeated damage in one frame
lethal damage ends run
defeat emits exactly one settlement event
duration completion produces victory rewards
victory emits exactly one settlement event
automatic spell collides and defeats an enemy
defeated enemy drops collectable EXP
abandon clears pending callbacks and choices
restarting never inherits prior run state

camera.notes: Movement bounds recompute from camera and HUD fractions. Sprite head (90% height) and foot (10% height) remain outside HUD lanes.

pauseStaticReview.focusLoss: running -> paused; sends Updated(snapshot); clears input
pauseStaticReview.focusReturn: does not auto-resume; explicit UI continue required
pauseStaticReview.upgradeState: external pause does not replace upgrade state or discard choices

input.desktop: WASD/arrows; click and drag outside interactive UI
input.uiContract: Large decorative Images must set raycastTarget=false; buttons/modal blockers may retain true

limitations: Unity editor compilation and actual engine execution have not been verified by this report.
Camera/rendering/physical touch and focus lifecycle checks are static review, not engine acceptance.
Character and enemy PNGs are static single frames with transform/flash feedback, not authored frame animations.
Battle background is the hand-painted arena-v1 UI scene plate with aspect-preserving camera cover; no navigable map or collision acceptance is claimed.
This report does not certify UI styling, screenshots, layout, or image generation.

testArtifacts.unityImport: Folder suffix ~ excludes the .NET harness from Unity imports

arenaPlate.operation: Direct texture reuse via centered Sprite.Create using decoded texture width/height; sortingOrder -100; uniform cover scaling to orthographic camera
arenaPlate.fallback: Explicit error and solid camera color only if the required plate is missing
arenaPlate.scope: UI demonstration scene plate; edge scenery has no new collision contract
